description: Elections Commission - The Media Guidelines under Article 104 B (5) (A) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette contains Media Guidelines issued by the Election Commission under Article 104 B(5)(a) of the Constitution. The content specifically addresses electoral processes, including regulations for media coverage during elections, requirements for balanced reporting of political parties and candidates, restrictions on election-related programming, and procedures for opinion polls. This falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes and regulations issued by the Election Commission.
